name: geqo_generations
description: Number of iterations performed by the Genetic Query Optimizer (GEQO) algorithm when planning complex joins.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for large JOINs
Excessive planning time for complex queries
Inconsistent plan selection across similar queries
tuning_tips: Set to 0 to use the default (derived from geqo_pool_size); increase only if GEQO consistently produces poor plans for complex queries, but avoid excessive values as they increase planning overhead.
